feature: P5-H5-TB HWP5 text-box paragraph split and adjacent boundary merge
supported: SAFE HWP5 Section0 body-owned top-level flat unlocked uncaptioned text boxes with no more than 64 ordinary, non-empty paragraphs. Enter at an interior caret splits one paragraph into adjacent paragraphs; Backspace at the adjacent paragraph boundary merges them. The split gets a globally unique paragraph instance ID. Paragraph/list counts, owner, record nesting/control levels, paragraph/style references, character-shape runs, paragraph raw tails, siblings and outer object geometry are preserved. HWPX behavior remains under its previous limits.
refused: Empty or structurally marked paragraphs; controls, fields, tabs, break/topology metadata, captions, groups, locks, ambiguous ownership, more than 64 paragraphs, HWP5 cross-paragraph IME replacement, and multiline paste replacing a non-collapsed selection. HWP5 multiline plain-text paste at a collapsed caret is accepted separately by P5-TB-REPLACE. Unsupported inputs fail before mutation.
